$comment: Performance lane (scripts/perf-lane.mjs): the realm the pack tests, and operations the lane must not send. The lane sends the admin client's token (qa-config auth), whose realm-management roles are view-realm, view-users, query-users, manage-users and query-groups (realm/qa-realm.json); every other operation it leaves out has an id the realm generates or a path parameter it has no value for. Measured on the pinned image, 2026-10-21.
